title: Ticketing
subtitle: {{brand}} brand · how tickets are shaped and routed

empty.heading: No departments yet
empty.body: A department decides where a ticket is filed and who can see it. Add the first one to start routing.

editor.heading: Edit department
editor.name: Name
editor.nameArHint: Optional. Printed under the Latin name on this list.
editor.defaultTeamHint: Where a ticket lands when no rule picks a team.

nothing.heading: Nothing selected
nothing.body: Choose a department to edit its name and its default team.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: Its teams and their members go with it. Tickets already filed under it have to be moved first.

teams.heading: Teams in {{name}}
teams.empty: No teams yet. A team is a group inside this department that work can be routed to.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: Its members keep their roles in the brand; only the team goes.

toast.failed: That did not work. Try again.
toast.outOfScope: You do not lead that department.
toast.lastDepartment: A brand keeps at least one department.
toast.departmentInUse: Tickets still belong to this department. Move them first.
toast.notEligible: That person holds no role in this brand that reaches this department.
toast.statusIsSystem: A seeded status can be renamed, never deleted.
toast.statusIsDefault: Make another status the default before deleting this one.
toast.statusStateFixed: A seeded status's system state and flags cannot change.
toast.defaultMustBeOpen: The default status is where a new or reopened ticket lands, so it has to be open.
toast.fieldInUse: Rows already carry values for this field, so its type cannot change.
toast.optionInUse: Rows still carry one of the options you removed.
toast.timeTrackingOff: Time tracking is off for this brand.

editor.heading: Edit status · {{name}}
editor.name: Name
editor.nameArHint: Optional. Shown to customers reading in Arabic.
editor.systemStateHint: What SLA maths and reports treat this status as.
editor.systemNote: A seeded status can be renamed and recoloured. Its state and flags are what the code refers to it by.

nothing.heading: Nothing selected
nothing.body: Choose a status to edit its name, its system state and its flags.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body_one: {{count}} ticket moves to {{fallback}}. This cannot be undone.
delete.body_other: {{count}} tickets move to {{fallback}}. This cannot be undone.

reply.heading: Reply behaviour
reply.autoAwait: Move to Awaiting customer when an agent sends a public reply
reply.autoAwaitHint: A customer reply moves the ticket back to Open.
reply.reopen: When a customer replies to a closed ticket
reply.days: days, otherwise a new linked ticket

empty.heading: No tags yet
empty.body: A tag is a label agents put on a ticket to find it again. Add the first one to start filing.

editor.heading: Edit tag
editor.name: Name
editor.nameArHint: Optional. Shown on the chip when the desk is in Arabic.

nothing.heading: Nothing selected
nothing.body: Choose a tag to edit its name and its colour.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body_one: {{count}} ticket keeps no tag. The ticket itself is untouched.
delete.body_other: {{count}} tickets keep no tag. The tickets themselves are untouched.

empty.heading: No custom fields yet
empty.body: A custom field keeps something this brand needs that Helpdock does not ship. Add the first one.

editor.heading: Edit field
editor.label: Label
editor.labelArHint: Optional. Shown when the desk is in Arabic.
editor.keyHint: Lower-case letters, digits and underscores. It cannot be changed afterwards.
editor.keyLocked: The key is fixed once the field exists, because every stored value is written under it.
editor.typeLocked: The type is fixed while rows carry a value for this field.
editor.optionsHint: One choice per row. Reorder with the arrow buttons or ↑ and ↓.
editor.requiredHint: A required field has to be filled in when a ticket is created.
editor.agentVisibleHint: Off keeps the field for administrators and rules. It hides it; it does not protect it.

nothing.heading: Nothing selected
nothing.body: Choose a field to edit its label, its type and its options.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body_one: {{count}} row carries a value for it. The value stays in the database and stops being shown.
delete.body_other: {{count}} rows carry a value for it. The values stay in the database and stop being shown.

force.title: Remove options that are in use?
force.body: Some rows still carry the options you removed. Saving clears the option from them.

empty.heading: No templates yet
empty.body: A template fills in the subject, the body and the fields of a ticket an agent files by hand. Add the first one.

editor.heading: Edit template
editor.name: Name
editor.subject: Subject
editor.bodyHint: Plain text in this release. The rich composer arrives with M5.
editor.defaultTagsHint: Applied to every ticket made from this template.

nothing.heading: Nothing selected
nothing.body: Choose a template to edit its subject, its body and what it fills in.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: Tickets already filed from it are untouched. Nothing else changes.

feedback.heading: Feedback and time
feedback.caption: Customer ratings and agent time for this brand.
feedback.csatEnabled: Ask for a rating when a ticket closes
feedback.csatHint: One link per ticket, 1 to 5 and a comment. It works once and expires after 30 days. Never sent for spam or merged tickets.
feedback.timeHint: Agents see a Time card on each ticket with a timer and manual entries.
feedback.timerWithComposer: Start the timer when an agent opens the composer
feedback.timerHint: Stopped and logged against the reply when it is sent.
feedback.deliveryBody: The link goes out with the closing message on the ticket's channel. Email, widget and Telegram delivery arrive with those channels; until then the link is shown on the ticket for the agent to share.
